title: A sufficiently positive ample twist of a coherent module is globally generated
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\mathcal L$ be an ample [def-sc-ample] invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\mathcal F$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there is an integer $d_0$ such that $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ is generated by global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] for every $d\ge d_0$; this means that the evaluation map from the direct sum of copies of $\mathcal O_X$ indexed by a family of global sections onto $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ is a sheaf epimorphism.

source.place: Properties, Proposition 01Q3 (properties-proposition-characterize-ample), the implication that a finite type module becomes globally generated after a sufficiently positive ample twist; Modules Definition 01AM (definition-globally-generated)

mathlib_searches.query: finite type quasi-coherent sheaf globally generated after tensoring with a sufficiently positive ample line bundle
mathlib_searches.results: No coherent-sheaf ampleness or global-generation theorem in Mathlib; only module and Proj primitives.

mathlib_searches.query: ample line bundle twist global sections generate coherent module
mathlib_searches.results: No match; results concern Proj basic opens and finite modules, not sheaf global generation.
No global-generation or ample-twist theorem for coherent sheaves in Mathlib.
